records.prompt: Design an original Nu Mou Physician full-body concept illustration for Final Fantasy Tactics Advance. The attached panel of original FFTA Nu Mou jobs is the authority for racial anatomy, compact proportions, clean ink lines and simple flat shaded colors. A tier-three field physician descended from Chemist and White Mage: gentle elderly Nu Mou with a broad long drooping muzzle, small readable eyes, very long pendulous ears, stooped rounded body and short limbs. A distinctive ivory open-front medical overcoat with a short dark teal shoulder yoke, warm ochre sleeve cuffs and a dark leather medicine case at the hip; a modest close-fitting ivory physician cap with a single teal band, ears fully exposed. A large simple brass clasp and two broad strapped dressing rolls, no tiny clutter. Keep the outfit clearly different from both the red-triangle White Mage and olive-capped Chemist, but equally believable in FFTA. Costume shapes must simplify into a 32x32 sprite. No modern surgical mask, no modern medical logos, no plague-doctor beak, no spectacles obscuring the eye, no staff hiding the body. Relaxed neutral full-body pose, one complete original character on white, no text. Match the reference illustration's economical detail and hand-inked style; do not repaint or decorate any existing character.
records.status: User approved direction: Yes, develop both directions

records.prompt: Design an original Moogle Sapper full-body concept illustration for Final Fantasy Tactics Advance. The attached panel of original FFTA Moogle jobs is the authority for racial anatomy, compact proportions, clean ink lines and simple flat shaded colors. A tier-three field engineer descended from Chemist and Gadgeteer, using charges, tripwires and smoke, NOT a gunner. Cream-white Moogle with small readable dark eyes, long upright ears, red pom-pom and small bat wings. A compact ochre leather engineer skullcap between exposed ears, dark teal padded short utility vest over an ivory shirt, warm orange leather gloves and sturdy little boots. Distinctive pair of rounded brass-rimmed safety goggles parked above the forehead, not covering the eyes. Broad diagonal belt with two simple squat dark charge canisters and a small square leather tool pouch at the hip. Simple robust silhouette, not an oversized modern bomb suit, not military camouflage, not a gas mask. No gun or firearm, no large held weapon, no sparks or explosion hiding the design. Original neutral full-body stance. Keep costume shapes economical enough for a 32x32 sprite and distinct from the existing Moogle Chemist and Gadgeteer. One complete original character on white, no text. Match the reference's hand-inked lines and flat shaded colors; do not recolor or decorate an existing character.
records.status: User approved direction: Yes, develop both directions
